evaluation_label_policy.invalid_source: retain sensor rows, mark all references and accuracy invalid, report evaluation_label_failure and exit2; never normalize, deduplicate or subset invalid labels

evidence_scope: prospectively fixed independent FR1 desk2 recording; unchanged descriptor-based visual reprojection estimator; one continuous origin, no reset or parameter retuning

feature_policy.descriptor: intensity-centroid oriented deterministic256bit BRIEF on5x5binomial blur
feature_policy.detector: fixed original FAST-9 threshold20 radius3, deterministic NMS,32pixel tile max2
feature_policy.matching: both directional strict 5*best<4*second, maximumHamming64, mutual nearest; ties rejected

freeze_preparation: This metadata-only preparation reads manifest and qualification proof only; raw RGB/depth/mocap files are not opened, features not extracted and registration not run; earlier opaque archive acquisition/decompression are separate

ground_truth_interpolation.method: linear translation and shortest-arc quaternion SLERP

json_metadata_audit.scope: source-manifest versus parsed freeze/report derived gap only; source SHA, acquisition timestamps and indices remain exact; no sensor association or fit gate change

preprocessing.luma: (77*R+150*G+29*B)>>8; RGB/RGBA8; RGBA must be fully opaque
preprocessing.pixel_coordinates: nearest integer feature coordinate, ties round away from zero
preprocessing.point: centre depth at feature pixel; optical x-right y-down z-forward

timestamps.summary_time_unit: rounded microseconds from source timestamps; qualification gates use unrounded seconds

qualification_order: source-bound timestamp and row-arity metadata before estimator opens selected PNG files, headers, features or fits; opaque compressed archive acquisition/decompression occur earlier; numeric ground-truth pose values only after all fits

refinement_policy.failure: reject without current root output or accepted reference/clock renewal; no coarse-pose fallback
refinement_policy.initial_pose: original previous_from_current robust3D fit, never motion-capture labels
refinement_policy.method: bounded Huber pixel reprojection, maximum8 iterations; convergence and work reported explicitly
refinement_policy.observations: only original robust3D inlier correspondence indices; previous measured depth point and matched current RGB feature pixel; fixed support throughout refinement
refinement_policy.pose: refined previous_from_current pose is composed into accepted root; coarse fit and pose are separate diagnostics

tracking_policy.pose: reference-root pose composed with measured refined previous_from_current pixel-reprojection pose
tracking_policy.reference: last accepted measured RGB features and depth image; initial root identity after measured geometry validation
tracking_policy.rejection: no root output or accepted clock/reference update; repeated/stale RGB timestamp versus last observed image rejects, including previously rejected fits; observed image clock advances without permission renewal; accepted-pose expiry checked before RGB freshness; evaluation never resets
